taskTitle: Enforce worker request and response requestId correlation
taskPrompt: Fix the HTTP workspace worker client so that refine, infill, and resolveConflict reject an otherwise valid worker response when its requestId does not exactly match the submitted request's requestId. Matching requestIds must remain accepted. Health behavior must remain unchanged. Add a focused regression using mocked or stubbed globalThis.fetch so no real network is required. Modify only packages/worker-contract/src/index.ts and tests/smoke/contracts.ts, respect the configured patch budget, and do not change endpoint construction, request payloads, timeout behavior, response schemas, dependencies, or unrelated validation.
requiredAssertions: refine rejects a mismatched response requestId
infill rejects a mismatched response requestId
resolveConflict rejects a mismatched response requestId
regression coverage uses mocked or stubbed globalThis.fetch without real network
only the two authorized files change
patch stays within the configured maxPatchLines budget
source worktree and GitHub remain immutable
